races.name: British Stallion Studs Ebf Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (for Horses In Bands B, C And D) (Ebf Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
Virgin Bet Every Saturday Money Back Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: Completely Random
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with a win and a place in his last five runs at Goodwood, but best course form is over 6f not 7f; Harry Charlton's 5yo is 28 days fresh with a positive sim-going record and Daniel Muscutt aboard, though the step up to this big field brings traffic risk from his rearward berth.
runners_data.comment: Completely Random shaped well when second three starts back and arrives here in good heart after 28 days off, with experience over today's trip and going working in his favour; our rating of 110 marks him out as the one to beat from stall 4 off 138 lb.

runners_data.name: Fondo Blanco
runners_data.note: Prominent racer for Roger Varian dropping in class from Listed company; won over 8f on soft and has placed at Goodwood before, but his record on quicker ground is modest (0W2P from 11 comparable runs) and the step back to 7f from 8f is yet to be proven as a benefit.
runners_data.comment: Fondo Blanco brings distance and going experience to the table and steps in off a 21-day break looking fresh, his 103 rating marking him second-best in the field, though his two most recent runs were unplaced and he must bounce back sharply under a hefty 135 lb.

runners_data.name: Pellitory
runners_data.note: David O'Meara's 4yo carries genuine Goodwood 7f credentials — one win and two places from 12 course-and-distance runs on similar ground — and Daniel Tudhope's experience in a busy field is a major plus; a patient prominent ride just off Ghost Mode's shoulder is his optimum shape.
runners_data.comment: Pellitory won last time out and has experience of today's trip and conditions, but three unplaced efforts in his last five starts temper expectations; 132 lb from stall 10 is no easy task, and he'll need to reproduce that recent best.

runners_data.name: Addison Grey
runners_data.note: Has won at this course and trip and boasts the widest W/P band of any prominent runner here (3W7P on similar going); Clifford Lee has ridden him to recent success and the 14-day turnaround following a win is the only flag, but Clive Cox's 5/24 strike rate supports confidence.
runners_data.comment: Addison Grey arrives on the back of a win last time out and has run over today's trip and going before, giving him solid claims at a competitive 131 lb; the main risk is that ninth two starts back hints at vulnerability on an off day.

runners_data.name: Forty Years On
runners_data.note: Hector Crouch partners a horse who has won four of his last five starts including twice on soft — the concern is that his best form comes on softer surfaces and his Good To Firm record is thin (2W2P from only 6 runs); 79 days off the track adds a small fitness question, but his raw ability is undeniable.
runners_data.comment: Forty Years On arrives on the back of four wins in her last five starts, with a runner-up finish two starts back the only blip in a rich vein of form, and has run over today's trip before; the concern is 79 days off the track and a hefty 130 lb to carry.

runners_data.name: The Fingal Raven
runners_data.note: Prominent type for Jamie Osborne who has run 14 of his last 15 starts on similar going at Goodwood — course familiarity is real, but his record reads 1W7P without a recent breakthrough and he has beaten only modest opposition; William Carver is a 3lb claimer which helps the weight.
runners_data.comment: Third last time out suggests The Fingal Raven is finding his form again after a difficult mid-season, and he has experience of today's distance and going; however, he carries 127 lb from stall 14, and has been winless in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Galeron
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse for Charles Hills who is 84 days off the track following a modest run; his sim-going record at Goodwood is only 8/15 and David Probert takes over for the first time, so there are meaningful fitness and positional questions from the rear of a 15-runner field.
runners_data.comment: Galeron shaped with promise when second three starts back and has experience over today's trip and going, with our rating of 102 putting him firmly in the mix as a leading danger; the main concern is that he returns after 84 days off and has been winless in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Ghost Mode
runners_data.note: The lone confirmed front-runner and the key pace figure; Andrew Balding's 3yo won over this course and trip last time out and Rob Hornby can dictate from the front on Good To Firm, making him the fulcrum around which every tactical decision in the race is built.
runners_data.comment: Fresh from a win last time out and with experience of today's distance and going, Ghost Mode arrives in fair heart carrying 126 lb from stall six; however, his record in recent starts shows three finishes outside the placings, suggesting consistency remains a question mark.

runners_data.name: Aalto
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with an excellent Goodwood record — 1W4P from 11 runs at the track over 7f — and Cieren Fallon is an experienced hand in a big field; the tongue-tie is noted and he is 35 days fresh, but his proven ability to finish through traffic on this course makes him one of the more credible closers in this race.
runners_data.comment: Ranked well down the field on our figures and up against it in a deep-looking contest, Aalto does arrive third last time out and with a win two starts back to his name, and he has experience of today's trip and conditions, but his rating of 92 makes him hard to fancy at face value.

runners_data.name: Carnival Of Light
runners_data.note: Charlie Johnston's 4yo has won twice recently but both came on soft or standard at Southwell and Catterick; his Goodwood record on quick ground is 0W0P from five visits and the 9-day turnaround after finishing tailed-off last time raises a freshness flag in this stronger company.
runners_data.comment: Ranked bottom of the field on our figures and with a speed rating that makes her hard to fancy at the weights, Carnival Of Light does bring a recent unbeaten run of two wins into this contest and has run over today's trip, though her latest start ended in an unplaced effort.

runners_data.name: Darkness
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse for David O'Meara who has form figures of 6-12-11-10-6 in his last five starts — the form string is uninspiring and his last two Goodwood 7f runs ended in double-figure finishes; Mark Winn's inexperience in a 15-runner handicap makes a clean passage from the rear very uncertain.
runners_data.comment: Darkness has been winless in his last six starts, finishing no better than sixth in that sequence, and ranked 12 of 15 on our figures he looks up against it here; he has run over today's trip and going before, and 29 days since his last outing suggests he arrives fresh.

runners_data.name: Rhoscolyn
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up operator by nature, though the field's depth of similar types means he is shown in midfield rather than at his preferred rear position — his recent record of 500500 and zero wins or places on comparable ground at Goodwood (0W0P) makes a winning intervention very unlikely regardless of where he settles; the 7-day turnaround is quick.
runners_data.comment: Rhoscolyn has run over today's trip and going, which counts in his favour, but he heads here winless in his last six starts with unplaced efforts dominating his recent form; back quickly after just seven days, he carries 118 lb from stall nine.

runners_data.name: Leadman
runners_data.note: Michael Appleby's 6yo has a win at Goodwood over 7f and a solid sim-going record (13/15), but his true inclination is to race from the rear and the crowded midfield he is forced into here compromises that plan; his form string of 061579 contains a recent 9th at Goodwood which tempers enthusiasm.
runners_data.comment: Leadman has won in his last six starts but that sole success is sandwiched between a string of moderate efforts, and ranking thirteenth of fifteen on our figures makes him hard to fancy; he does have experience over today's trip and going, and 21 days between runs suggests he arrives fresh.

runners_data.name: Rare Change
runners_data.note: Gina Mangan partners a 4yo who has won three times on similar going in the last 12 months, giving him the best strike rate of the hold-up group; however, his natural back-of-the-field style is squeezed out by the depth of hold-up types here, and his finishing efforts in big Goodwood fields have been inconsistent.
runners_data.comment: Rare Change has finished seventh in each of his last two starts and ranks 14th of 15 on our figures, making him hard to fancy; he does at least return fit on 13 days' rest and has experience of today's trip and going.

runners_data.name: Ironwill
runners_data.note: Naturally a prominent racer — has won and placed from the front — but is mapped to midfield because the prominent positions are already oversubscribed; J F Egan is experienced but starting from a displaced position in a 15-runner handicap eight days after his last run means this 3yo may never get into the race from where he ends up.
runners_data.comment: Ironwill showed his best when winning three starts back and was second two starts back, but has disappointed since, finishing unplaced last time out just eight days ago; he has run over today's trip and going, carries 116 lb from stall 11, and our rating of 95 suggests more is possible.

races.paceDynamic: Ghost Mode is the lone confirmed front-runner and, with no genuine challenger for the lead, Rob Hornby can dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front on Good To Firm ground at Goodwood's 7f. Behind him, a cluster of prominent-minded horses — Fondo Blanco, Pellitory, Addison Grey, Forty Years On, The Fingal Raven, and Carnival Of Light — will all be fighting for the first two or three positions behind the leader, creating significant congestion and potential traffic trouble between the 2f and 3f markers. Ironwill, though a natural prominent type, has been pushed into midfield on the map because there is simply no room for all of them to race where they want, and several hold-up horses — Rhoscolyn, Leadman, and Rare Change — are similarly out of their natural position, meaning the rear of the field is thinner in true closers than it appears. The race shape strongly favours a patient, well-placed prominent racer who can settle just off Ghost Mode's uncontested lead and quicken through a clean gap in the straight, rewarding runners with tactical speed and Goodwood course form over pure late-running ability.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ghost Mode Soft Lead Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Ghost Mode is allowed his uncontested lead and the prominent pack burns itself out scrapping for position behind.
scenarios.body: Ghost Mode dictates a comfortable tempo on Good To Firm ground, the prominent scrimmage 2-3f out burns energy from those trying to pass him, and he rolls on strongly up the hill to the line; Andrew Balding's 3yo has already won at this course and trip and his front-running record over 7f at Goodwood is the key asset here.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Scrimmage Suits Settler
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack battles hard for position, leaving one cool-headed, well-placed handler to glide through on the bridle in the straight.
scenarios.body: A prominent runner who escapes the early traffic war and travels comfortably just behind Ghost Mode emerges with a double handful turning for home; Pellitory and Addison Grey both have proven Goodwood 7f form and the tactical awareness to find that sweet spot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Carnage Frees Midfield
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent logjam causes genuine interference and checking 2-3f out, opening a late run for a midfield tracker.
scenarios.body: A runner sitting quietly in midfield avoids the scrimmage entirely and cuts through the gaps as the prominent pack ties each other up; Aalto and Completely Random, both proven at this course and trip, have the tactical versatility to benefit from late chaos, though Completely Random's best form is over 6f.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: True Closers Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If the tempo is faster than it appears and genuine hold-up runners find a clear run from off the pace.
scenarios.body: This shape depends on Rhoscolyn, Leadman, and Rare Change racing in their true natural position — but all three are redistributed from their preferred rear berth and are unlikely to find that ground in this field; even if the pace collapses their ability to thread through 15 runners from the back on Good To Firm ground makes this the least-likely outcome.

watchPoints.text: Ghost Mode (Ghost Mode) is the sole front-runner in a 15-runner field — if he is allowed a soft lead with no pressure, he may never be headed; watch whether any of the prominent pack (Pellitory, Addison Grey, Forty Years On) test him early, because if they don't, this race could be over before the 2f marker.

The prominent logjam — Fondo Blanco, Pellitory, Addison Grey, Forty Years On, The Fingal Raven, and Carnival Of Light all targeting the same three positions — creates a high probability of bumping, checking, or crowding between the 3f and 2f marks; any runner caught in traffic at that point loses their race.

Ironwill is a natural prominent type racing from a displaced midfield position due to field overcrowding; watch his early strides — if J F Egan pushes forward to reclaim a prominent berth, he could trigger a chain reaction that accelerates the tempo and changes the entire race shape.

Forty Years On is unbeaten in his last five completed starts but two of those wins came on soft ground; on Good To Firm conditions his proven form is limited, and after 79 days off the track any sign of stiffness or greenness on the firmer surface should be noted before reading too much into his opening price.

Rhoscolyn, Leadman, and Rare Change — all genuine hold-up horses — are effectively racing out of position in this field; if the pace is genuinely strong and the field strings out, one of them could find late daylight, but monitor in-running positions early to see whether any manage to drift back to their natural rear berth or are trapped wide in midfield.

races.name: Virgin Bet A Good Bet Handicap Stakes (gbbplus Race)

runners_data.name: Lord Melbourne
runners_data.note: A persistent prominent racer for Ralph Beckett who has solid Goodwood course form but returns after 84 days off; his recent form figures of 6-5095 are uninspiring and he needs to find improvement on those efforts to feature, though the step back up to 1m4f after shorter trips suits.
runners_data.comment: Lord Melbourne has run over today's trip and going before and, carrying 142 lb off a mark of 96, arrives here 84 days since his last start with our rating putting him right in contention — though his recent string of out-of-the-money finishes means he remains yet to score in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: High Degree
runners_data.note: The race's key pace ingredient — William Haggas's four-year-old has won and placed repeatedly on this course and goes exceptionally well fresh (13 days since last run); his hg headgear is retained and he faces no credible early challenger, giving Fallon total control of the tempo.
runners_data.comment: High Degree arrives on the back of a win last time out and has prior experience of today's going, so conditions should hold no fears; the main risk is whether he can reproduce that form under a stiff 141 lb.

runners_data.name: Too Soon
runners_data.note: Genuine hold-up operator returning after 84 days for Gary & Josh Moore; he has won and placed at this trip on soft ground but his zero wins and zero places from 15 similar-going runs is a stark flag, and he will need a truly run race that this pace map is unlikely to produce.
runners_data.comment: Too Soon brings strong recent form — a winner last time out and carrying just 140 lb with an official mark of 94 — and has experience of today's distance and going. The 84-day absence is the one factor to weigh up.

runners_data.name: Tony Montana
runners_data.note: A prominent racer with 13 from 15 runs on good-to-firm ground, giving him excellent going credentials; Kevin Philippart De Foy's six-year-old finished second here over 10f earlier this year and Clifford Lee will look to use his Goodwood familiarity to press for a prominent pitch, but OR=94 has proved difficult to win off.
runners_data.comment: Tony Montana shaped with promise when second five starts back, and he has experience over today's trip and going, but he has been winless in recent starts and must bounce back from a modest run 32 days ago, with his rating of 105 marking him as the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Rathgar
runners_data.note: Multiple Goodwood winner (three wins from 11 runs here) who must be respected on this course and going; David Probert's mount has dropped 3lb off an OR=93 and carries prominent headgear, making him the most course-trusted of the prominent group chasing High Degree, though his last-time-out tenth at Goodwood needs excusing.
runners_data.comment: Rathgar won twice in his last six starts but has since slipped to unplaced last time out, and a ninth three starts back tempers expectations; he has run over today's trip and going, carries 139 lb, and our rating of 97 sits a touch above his official 93, ranking him fifth of nine.

runners_data.name: Haku
runners_data.note: A true hold-up horse who carries Charles Bishop for Mark Loughnane; his one run in similar going (1/15) is almost comically stark, though his three placed efforts over 12f on good ground elsewhere suggest the trip suits — he simply needs the ground to be playing fairer for hold-up types than this shape suggests.
runners_data.comment: Haku showed up with a third last time out and a winner four starts back, so he retains ability, but that seventh two starts back is a concern; he has run over today's trip and going, carries 134 lb off an official mark of 88, and a 28-day break leaves fitness to prove.

runners_data.name: Oneforthegutter
runners_data.note: A hold-up specialist for Ian Williams who has finished seventh or eighth in six of his last seven starts; wearing a tongue-tie and carrying OR=86, his consistent backmarker finishes and poor similar-going record (1 from 15) make it very hard to see where improvement comes from in this controlled-pace scenario.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, with three eighths and two sevenths the sum of his recent efforts, Oneforthegutter is hard to fancy from eighth in the ratings here, though he has run over today's trip and going before and returns on a reasonable 21-day break.

runners_data.name: Classical Allusion
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding's four-year-old has strong trainer form (11/66 over 14 days) and has won twice over 12f; a prominent-style runner who finished second at Sandown on similar ground, he is lightly exposed at this trip and could outrun his OR=82 if the mid-race congestion works in his favour — his course record of 6/12f on similar going is the positive.

runners_data.name: Green Sky
runners_data.note: Rod Millman's six-year-old carries a fine sequence (451114) and is a genuine hold-up horse by nature; placed in the midfield section on this map only because the rear is oversubscribed, and Charlie Tucker (7) rides — the STYLE_FIT flag of 0.94 confirms he is unlikely to get his natural position in this shape, which tempers his chance despite excellent recent form.
runners_data.comment: Green Sky has shown she can win, with victories two, three and four starts back, but she is ranked last of all runners on our figures and that speed rating of 74 is hard to dismiss, even with the fourth last time out suggesting no obvious decline; distance and going experience at least means conditions hold no fresh unknowns.

races.paceDynamic: High Degree is the confirmed lone front-runner here and, with no other genuine pace-maker to force the issue, Cieren Fallon can dictate on a fully uncontested lead over 1m4f on Good to Firm Goodwood ground — conditions that suit his record (9/11 in similar going). The four prominent runners — Lord Melbourne, Tony Montana, Rathgar, and Classical Allusion — will jostle for position behind him through the early stages, creating a congestion risk between two and three furlongs out that could cause interference or force some of them to race wider than ideal. Green Sky is a genuine hold-up horse who has been mapped to midfield because the rear of the field is saturated; this field carries more front-running and prominent types than the track can accommodate cleanly, with Rathgar and Tony Montana best placed to secure a forward berth given their course familiarity and handlers' intentions. The race shape strongly favours a horse that can sit just off a single, controlled pace-setter and produce a sustained gallop into the straight — meaning on-pace prominent types with good Goodwood form are the primary beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: High Degree Controls Cleanly
scenarios.trigger: If High Degree leads uncontested and sets a measured, honest gallop that only quickens from two out.
scenarios.body: Fallon allows High Degree to bowl along at a sustainable tempo, and with no one willing to go with him, he builds a decisive lead into the Goodwood straight that hold-up horses cannot bridge; his 9/11 record in similar going underlines how well he handles these conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Overhaul Leader
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack — particularly Rathgar or Lord Melbourne — track High Degree closely enough to strike as he ties up late.
scenarios.body: High Degree's long-distance effort takes its toll inside the final furlong, allowing a prominent racer who has been travelling comfortably in second or third to collar him close home; Rathgar's multiple Goodwood wins and Lord Melbourne's course familiarity make them the likeliest beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Storms Home
scenarios.trigger: If High Degree's pace proves genuinely strong enough to set up a proper end-to-end gallop that rewards late finishers.
scenarios.body: A truly run race stretches the field and leaves a path for a horse who has been held up for a late run, surging through a tiring field inside the final furlong; Too Soon or Haku, both genuine hold-up types, are best suited to this shape, though the lack of a pressured early pace makes this scenario unlikely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace, Chaos Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion mid-race produces interference or checked runs two to three furlongs out, scrambling the expected order.
scenarios.body: A chaotic mid-race incident disrupts the smooth pace High Degree is setting, compressing the field and allowing an unconsidered runner to profit from the shuffle; Classical Allusion's Andrew Balding training form and Tony Montana's class make them situational beneficiaries if rivals lose momentum.

watchPoints.text: High Degree's uncontested lead is the defining factor — if Cieren Fallon is allowed to bowl along at will from flag to finish, the race is almost certainly his to lose, and nothing in this field has either the pace or the rider intent to go with him early.

The four prominent runners — Lord Melbourne, Tony Montana, Rathgar, and Classical Allusion — are all likely to seek the same early berths directly behind High Degree, and the resulting congestion between two and three furlongs out at Goodwood creates a genuine interference risk, particularly for those on the wide outside.

Green Sky's redistribution from his natural hold-up position to the midfield on this map is a key nuance — his recent form (451114 including three wins) flatters him, but if he cannot settle into his natural role from the rear he may race too freely and underperform relative to expectations.

Too Soon and Haku are the only confirmed hold-up horses with genuine staying form, but both face the same problem: a lone front-runner controlling pace rarely generates the end-to-end gallop that brings hold-up horses into play, and their similar-going records are both poor.

Rathgar's course record demands respect — three wins at Goodwood and four more placed efforts — and if David Probert can position him second or third without burning energy in the prominent scramble, he is the horse most likely to overhaul High Degree if the favourite does tie up in the final furlong.

races.name: Virgin Bet Celebration Mile Stakes (Group 2)

runners_data.name: Boiling Point
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner in the race and thoroughly at home at Goodwood, with course form of 2-4-3 over similar trips and strong similar-going figures (12 from 15); Clifford Lee can control the tempo and the drop to a flat mile suits a horse who won over ten furlongs here in June.
runners_data.comment: Boiling Point arrives on the back of a placed effort last time out and has experience of today's trip and conditions, with 133 lb from stall one his key test.

runners_data.name: Ebt's Guard
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer with five consecutive Goodwood starts at this trip, handling this going well (11 from 15), though a single win from a long sequence of placed efforts raises questions about whether he can land a blow at this class level under Tudhope.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts, Ebt's Guard nonetheless showed a hint of form with a third three starts back, and 21 days between runs leaves him reasonably fresh; however, ranked sixth of nine on our assessment, he looks a midfield proposition at best.

runners_data.name: Fast Tracker
runners_data.note: Genuine hold-up horse by nature, placed in midfield on this map because the field is flush with rearward types; a 177-day absence is significant and he has been competing at Haydock and Wolverhampton lately — fitness and positional compromise both weigh against him here.
runners_data.comment: Unexposed and open to improvement, Fast Tracker returns after 177 days off carrying 133 lb from stall 5, with a win two starts back hinting at ability worth respecting on his reappearance.

runners_data.name: Naqeeb
runners_data.note: True hold-up type with excellent Goodwood experience (14 from 15 on similar going) and a win over ten furlongs on soft last time, but the drop to a flat mile with no guaranteed strong pace to close into makes this race shape difficult for Ryan Sexton to navigate from the rear.
runners_data.comment: Naqeeb landed a win four starts back but has managed only fifth, fifth on either side of a runner-up finish in his last three outings, and 49 days off the track adds a fitness query; he has run over today's trip and going before, though 133 lb is a stiff ask.

runners_data.name: Qirat
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won over seven furlongs at Goodwood in July, though his best form at this trip has come on softer ground (7-4 on similar going compared to 8 from 15 overall); Hector Crouch will need the pace to genuinely collapse for him to reproduce that winning effort.
runners_data.comment: Qirat brings a win three starts back and has run over today's trip and going, giving him key experience, while 31 days between runs keeps him fresh at 133 lb from stall eight; the main risk is his ninth last time out suggesting he needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Seagulls Eleven
runners_data.note: Has won on soft ground twice recently but his Goodwood form shows a tendency to finish well without always getting there (0 wins from 5 at the track); David Probert will rely on a strong enough gallop to set up a late run, which this race shape may not provide.
runners_data.comment: Seagulls Eleven boasts two wins and a third in his last five starts, has experience of today's trip and conditions, and 31 days between runs leaves him fresh; the main risk is that unplaced effort last time out.

runners_data.name: Arisaig
runners_data.note: A hold-up horse by habit, pushed into a midfield berth on this map due to the density of rearward types — all six of his recent Goodwood runs came over this trip but he has yet to win there; Callum Shepherd faces a tactical puzzle with a horse operating out of his preferred role.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts, Arisaig faces a stiff ask ranked seventh of nine on our figures, and a seventh last time out does little to inspire confidence; she has run over today's trip and going before, and 130 lb from stall four are the neutral facts to weigh.

runners_data.name: Pina Sonata
runners_data.note: Prominent racer whose only similar-going form reads 0 wins and 0 places from 2 runs at Goodwood — a concern — though a convincing win at Sandown on good ground in July shows he can be competitive when conditions are right; Daniel Muscutt will try to track Boiling Point and quicken around the home turn.
runners_data.comment: Ranked eighth of nine on our figures and out of the frame on her last two starts, Pina Sonata has plenty to prove, though she has run over today's trip and going before and returns from a 35-day break.

runners_data.name: Zavateri
runners_data.note: Three-year-old taking on older horses, but his form figures include a win over seven furlongs at Goodwood on good ground and he handles this surface well (7 from 8, four wins); Charles Bishop on a horse who races prominently and quickens — a profile that maps onto this race shape very comfortably.
runners_data.comment: Zavateri posted a second three starts back and has since kept respectable company in his last two outings; experience over today's trip and going works in his favour, and our rating of 120 marks him as the one to beat from stall six carrying 127 lb.

races.paceDynamic: Boiling Point is the lone confirmed front-runner in this nine-runner Group 2, and on Good to Firm ground at Goodwood over a mile he is set to dictate an honest but sustainable gallop without any rival likely to seriously challenge him for the lead — Ebt's Guard, Pina Sonata, and Zavateri will track up prominently but none figures to press him hard enough to force a breakneck tempo. The result is a controlled, single-pace race with a genuine but manageable gallop that will keep the hold-up horses under pressure to find a clear run as they negotiate Goodwood's sweeping home bend and relatively short straight. The field contains more genuine hold-up horses than can all operate from their natural rear positions — Fast Tracker and Arisaig are both true closers who are mapped to midfield because the glut of rearward types forces positional compromise, meaning their typical finishing kicks may be partially compromised. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can settle just off the pace, control their energy through the bend, and produce a sustained run from two furlongs out — a settled pace with no dramatic late injection punishes true closers and rewards those in the first three or four.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Lead, Prominent Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Boiling Point sets a fair but uncontested gallop and the race is decided by those who tracked him from the start.
scenarios.body: Boiling Point dictates from the front and the prominent trio of Ebt's Guard, Pina Sonata, and Zavateri are ideally placed to deliver their challenges around the two-furlong pole; on Good to Firm Goodwood ground this surface rewards those who save energy through the middle of the race rather than chasing from the rear. The winner is most likely to emerge from the first four or five at the two-furlong mark, where a sustained rather than explosive finishing effort is what the shape demands.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late, Closers Arrive
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is quicker than expected and Boiling Point's effort drains significantly inside the final furlong.
scenarios.body: A faster-than-anticipated tempo would open a genuine gap for the hold-up horses to close through, with Qirat and Seagulls Eleven — both capable of finishing strongly off a true pace — best placed to exploit any fade. Naqeeb has the Goodwood form to figure if stamina becomes the deciding factor, though the lack of a real pace-presser makes this outcome genuinely unlikely.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the gallop is so modest that Boiling Point simply outstays his field by controlling every yard of the race.
scenarios.body: Clifford Lee is an astute judge of pace and could deliberately set a tempo that makes it impossible for rivals to build enough momentum to reel him in before the line; Boiling Point has course form and handles this going well, making a front-running victory plausible if the challengers all leave it too late. His recent run at Goodwood over nine furlongs where he finished second suggests he retains ability, and dropping back to a flat mile here could sharpen his early speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Shuffle, Hold-Up Lands
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is uneven and the field concertinas entering the straight, creating a traffic-free lane for a late thrust.
scenarios.body: This scenario relies on Fast Tracker or Arisaig finding their natural hold-up roles despite being mapped to midfield, a double discount given both are operating out of their preferred positions — the probability is low precisely because the shape does not set up for them. Even if a pocket of late pace appears, the compacted field on a track where position on the bend matters makes a pure closer victory the least likely outcome.

watchPoints.text: Zavateri carries the highest OR in his age group, races prominently, and his Goodwood win on similar going makes him the standout profile match for this race shape — watch whether Bishop positions him just off Boiling Point through the bend.

Boiling Point's true pace through the middle of the race is critical — if Clifford Lee allows the tempo to be genuinely modest, the prominent horses behind him will arrive fresh and his lead may not be enough to hold them off.

Fast Tracker's 177-day absence is a significant fitness flag; even if he finds his feet positionally, a first run back at Group 2 level over a flat mile after nearly six months off is a substantial ask.

The cluster of hold-up horses — Naqeeb, Qirat, Seagulls Eleven, Fast Tracker, and Arisaig — all need the pace to collapse to land a blow; watch whether any of them manage to get a forward position from the draw that changes their tactical situation at the start.

Pina Sonata's similar-going form at Goodwood is weak (0 from 2 placed), which is a small but notable flag for a horse who will be close to the pace throughout — if the ground rides faster than expected on the day, monitor whether Muscutt adjusts his positioning.

races.name: Darley Ebf Maiden Fillies' Stakes (gbb Race)

runners_data.name: Aunt Roberta
runners_data.note: High-class OR-120 filly from George Scott whose last two runs at Goodwood include a fourth over 10f — she is a genuine hold-up horse by style yet the density of wait-and-see types in this field means she is unlikely to get the wide berth and late surge she needs, tempering confidence despite the talent.

runners_data.name: Chimes Of Thunder
runners_data.note: The lone confirmed front-runner, William Haggas placing her here after a string of placed efforts at Goodwood; David Probert knows the course well and can use that to control fractions over 1m2f, making her the key pace influence regardless of her OR-75 rating.

runners_data.name: Evening Call
runners_data.note: Haggas newcomer who was third on debut at Goodwood over 8f on identical going only 15 days ago — Cieren Fallon's booking adds significant confidence, the step up to 1m2f looks logical for a filly bred to get further, and she arrives with the freshest race form in the field.

runners_data.name: Marquetry
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding debut runner with Rob Hornby up and an OR-120 ceiling — completely unexposed and style unknown, which makes probability assignment difficult, but Balding's record with lightly-raced middle-distance fillies at summer meetings is a genuine positive angle.

runners_data.name: Mathoura
runners_data.note: Joe Tickle's filly has placed twice over 10f at Goodwood and goes well on this ground, but her true hold-up style is compromised in this race because the rear of the field is congested — Taylor Fisher will need to find a wider path than usual to deliver her run from an effective midfield berth.

runners_data.name: Pseudonym
runners_data.note: Ollie Sangster's OR-120 filly showed little on her only start (ninth, soft ground, 9f) and carries a stamina-fading flag from that effort; the step up in trip to 1m2f is at least logical, but 79 days off and a single unimpressive run make Daniel Tudhope's task opaque.

runners_data.name: Queen Of Scotland
runners_data.note: George Boughey debut filly with Hector Crouch — style and ability unknown, but Boughey has been among the most potent trainers with first-time-out maidens over middle distances in 2024-25, and the OR-120 band suggests connections hold her in high regard.

runners_data.name: Tropical Sands
runners_data.note: Ed Walker's filly brings consistent placed form including a second over 10f at Goodwood 22 days ago — her unknown-style tag on that evidence conceals a horse who runs competitively and handles this exact track and trip, making Clifford Lee's positioning in the early stages the key variable.

races.paceDynamic: Chimes Of Thunder is the sole confirmed front-runner in this eight-runner maiden and will stride to the front from the outset, setting a controlled, sustainable tempo over 1m2f on Good to Firm ground at Goodwood. With no other genuine pace horse to challenge her, she faces minimal early pressure and can dictate her own fractions, which at this trip on fast ground typically produces a steadily-run first half that compresses the field before a stern final two furlongs. The field actually contains more hold-up horses than the race shape can accommodate at the back — Aunt Roberta and Mathoura are true hold-up types who have been redistributed to midfield positions in the map because the rear is already crowded, meaning neither will race in their most natural position. This race shape — a single front-runner setting a fair but unforced gallop with the bulk of the field tracking through midfield — strongly favours horses with the class and tactical fluency to travel prominently or in mid-division and produce a sustained late run, rather than deep closers who need a true pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Chimes Leads, Class Closes
scenarios.trigger: If Chimes Of Thunder sets a fair, uncontested gallop and the class fillies track her before powering past in the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: Chimes Of Thunder controls the tempo without being pressured, keeping fractions honest enough that midfield horses move smoothly through; the superior OR-rated fillies — particularly those making racecourse debuts with strong breeding/trainer backing — have the acceleration on Good to Firm ground to mow her down.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Debutantes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If one or both unexposed debutantes (Marquetry, Queen Of Scotland) show exceptional raw ability to hit the front or move decisively into contention from the off.
scenarios.body: An unknown quantity with a top trainer and jockey can sidestep the form book entirely on debut over a trip that rewards stamina and class; the lack of race-day evidence for these runners cuts both ways, and Goodwood's contours over 1m2f often expose natural runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sticks
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is so modest and Chimes Of Thunder so well-judged in her ride that no one can close the gap in time.
scenarios.body: David Probert manages fractions expertly, killing the race as a contest through the final turn, and hold-up types displaced into midfield lack the acceleration to reel her back on fast ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens dramatically through the middle portion, stringing the field out and leaving genuine hold-up types with ground to make up late.
scenarios.body: This scenario is structurally weakened because Aunt Roberta and Mathoura — the truest hold-up types — are not operating from their preferred rear position, limiting their ability to produce the deep late runs this shape depends on; only a significant mid-race injection of pace would open the door.

watchPoints.text: Chimes Of Thunder and David Probert — if Probert steals a march and establishes a two-length lead through the first half-mile unchallenged, assess whether the rest of the field has the tempo awareness to close before Goodwood's final bend.

Aunt Roberta and Mathoura are both true hold-up horses who will be operating from midfield rather than the rear — watch the opening furlong to see whether either jockey accepts the unusual position or fights for ground, which could compromise their finish.

Evening Call's reappearance after just 15 days is short by any measure — watch early in the paddock and in the opening furlongs for any sign of physical or behavioural freshness that might indicate she is not fully at ease returning so quickly.

Both debutantes, Marquetry and Queen Of Scotland, carry top OR-120 ratings and unknown styles — watch the stalls for early positioning intent, as first-time-out fillies at Goodwood over 1m2f who break cleanly and race prominently tend to outperform those who miss the break and are forced wide.

Tropical Sands's 10f Goodwood placing 22 days ago is the most directly comparable piece of form in the race — watch how she travels through the first half of the race to gauge whether the field's overall standard has moved on from that effort.

races.name: Virgin Bet Daily Price Boosts Handicap Stakes (gbbplus Race)

runners_data.name: Caprelo
runners_data.note: Prominent-racing five-year-old with two wins over this exact 16f trip at Sandown and a place at Goodwood, returning after 52 days off for Hughie Morrison whose yard is quiet at T14 (0/7); blinkered, and the Good to Firm ground is no concern based on sim-going record.
runners_data.comment: Caprelo shaped with promise when second three starts back and has experience of today's trip and going to call on, with our rating edging him clear of his mark; the concern is five weeks off the track and consecutive minor efforts since that placed run.

runners_data.name: Scarlet Moon
runners_data.note: Front-runner with two wins and five places in 15 similar-going runs, has raced at Goodwood over 14f-16f and proven willing from the front; Archie Watson's T14 form (2/20) is quiet but Pierre-Louis Jamin is a sharp tactical rider who will ensure this one gets first run.
runners_data.comment: Scarlet Moon has won in recent starts but a subsequent unplaced effort clouds his claims, and he sits ninth of twelve on our figures, making him difficult to fancy at the weights with 135 lb to carry; he does at least bring distance and going experience to the table.

runners_data.name: Bright Legend
runners_data.note: Hold-up stayer returning quickly (10 days) for small yard Faye Bramley; has form over 20f at Goodwood but the drop to 16f and Good to Firm ground should suit given a SOF win over 20f; Clifford Lee will need to find daylight from the rear in what could be a congested straight.
runners_data.comment: Bright Legend is the top-rated runner here and showed what he is capable of with a win five starts back, while a fourth last time out — just 10 days ago — suggests he remains in form carrying 135 lb.

runners_data.name: Appier
runners_data.note: Seven-year-old hold-up performer with genuine Goodwood course form including a win over 14f on soft; David Probert rides, and with just two similar-going places in 15 runs, consistency is the concern, but Tony Carroll's yard fired 3/36 at T14 suggesting horses are running to form.
runners_data.comment: Placed third last time out and a winner two starts back, Appier has experience of today's distance and going in his favour, though a sixth and an unplaced run before that win temper confidence; fit enough on 36 days off, he carries 134 lb here.

runners_data.name: Russian Rumour
runners_data.note: Nine-year-old with an exceptional Goodwood record — two wins and six places in 15 similar-going starts — held up and very consistent at this track; Olivia Tubb claims 5lb which is a significant aid on 133lbs, and the step up to 16f from recent 14f outings looks a positive for this stayer.
runners_data.comment: Russian Rumour has been a model of consistency, finishing third three of her last four starts and winning one start back from that, and she has experience over today's trip and going; the concern is whether she can convert that solid placed form into a victory under 133 lb.

runners_data.name: Zachary Hickes
runners_data.note: Unexposed four-year-old who won impressively over 12f at Goodwood last time for Roger Varian (T14: 6/17, in excellent nick); stepping up significantly to 16f for the first time, so stamina is the key unknown, but Jack Mitchell is a reliable partner for a horse feeling its way into a longer trip.
runners_data.comment: Landed a win last time out to arrive here in form, and having run over today's going before he is no stranger to the conditions; however, ranked eighth of twelve on speed figures, he faces a stiff ask off 133 lb against stronger company.

runners_data.name: Gooloogong
runners_data.note: Prominent-racing six-year-old with a 16f win at Sandown and Goodwood course form including a place over 20f; Benoit de la Sayette rides for George Baker whose yard is quiet at T14 (0/5), but the trip and going are right, and this horse runs well fresh (29 days).
runners_data.comment: Ranked tenth of twelve on our figures and carrying 133 lb, Gooloogong is hard to fancy despite a third last time out and a win four starts back; he has experience of today's distance and going, but his speed rating of 68 leaves plenty to find.

runners_data.name: Arcturus Flame
runners_data.note: In-form four-year-old who has placed at 12f-14f at Goodwood six times in similar going — though his true role is as a hold-up performer, the surplus of closers in this field means Cieren Fallon will likely have him racing closer to midfield than he'd prefer, making his natural finishing kick harder to deploy; the tongue-tie is noted.
runners_data.comment: Arcturus Flame arrives on the back of a runner-up finish last time out, with distance and going experience working in his favour and a rating of 84 suggesting he is well treated on official figures — the main concern is that he remains winless in recent starts.

runners_data.name: Mr Freedom
runners_data.note: Prominent-racing seven-year-old suited by 14f-20f at Goodwood with two wins in similar going; returns after 59 days for small yard Sheena West (T14: 1/4), and while course form is solid, the long break and modest yard form are reasons for caution despite the tongue-tie being retained.
runners_data.comment: Mr Freedom arrives on a 59-day break and is yet to win in recent starts, with a distant eighth last time out offsetting a third three starts back; experience over today's trip and going helps, though 132 lb is a stiff ask for a gelding rated 77.

runners_data.name: Taritino
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up performer by nature with four wins from 15 similar-going runs and impressive recent Goodwood form — yet the field's concentration of closers means Taylor Fisher is unlikely to get this horse to its preferred last-to-first position; running at 16f for the first time after a string of 12f-14f runs, stamina will be tested.
runners_data.comment: Taritino won two of his last five starts, with consecutive victories three and four starts back, though he has returned a pair of fourths in his two most recent outings; he has run over today's trip and going, and 25 days off should leave him fresh enough to reverse that slide.

runners_data.name: Educator
runners_data.note: Serial winner over 12f-14f at Goodwood with blinkered headgear retained; Daniel Tudhope rides for Henrietta Knight (T14: 0/4), and though this horse's natural hold-up style suits a Goodwood straight, the redistribution of so many closers into midfield means clean air may be elusive — the step to 16f is also a question mark given all five recent runs are shorter.
runners_data.comment: Ranked 11 of 12 on our figures, Educator faces a stiff ask under 130 lb, yet his recent form reads better than his ranking suggests — a winner two starts back and again last time out, with experience over today's trip and going at least lending familiarity.

runners_data.name: Two Plus Two
runners_data.note: Front-runner with two wins and four places from 15 similar-going runs, all at 12f-14f — this 16f trip is a career first and the primary concern; Gina Mangan has ridden this horse to a big weight drop to OR=60 which eases the burden, and Ed de Giles' yard (T14: 0/5) is quiet, but Two Plus Two's willingness from the front could make them a key pace influence even if stamina gives way late.
runners_data.comment: Ranked bottom of the field on our figures, Two Plus Two is hard to fancy despite a record that shows a second last time out and a winner five starts back; he has experience over today's trip and going, but that profile offers only slim encouragement.

races.paceDynamic: Scarlet Moon and Two Plus Two are the two confirmed front-runners in this 12-runner 1m6f handicap on Good to Firm ground at Goodwood, and with both likely to want the lead, expect a competitive battle for the front from the off rather than a slow-burn procession. Scarlet Moon has the stronger form credentials and is ridden by Pierre-Louis Jamin for Archie Watson, giving her a slight edge to dictate, but Two Plus Two won over 14f here and will not concede ground cheaply, meaning the gallop should be honest and sustained throughout. The field holds more hold-up types than the map can comfortably place at the rear — Arcturus Flame, Taritino, and Educator are genuine come-from-behind performers who are mapped to midfield because they cannot all secure their natural position — meaning the middle of the pack will be congested and those three face compromised situations. A genuinely-run 1m6f on fast ground suits prominent racers who can travel smoothly just off the pace and deliver a controlled, relentless finish — horses with Goodwood course form, proven stamina, and the ability to race prominently without burning out are the primary beneficiaries of this shape.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Lead, Honest Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Scarlet Moon and Two Plus Two fight for the front and sustain a true gallop throughout, setting up a race that stretches stamina and rewards those travelling efficiently just off the pace.
scenarios.body: Scarlet Moon, having raced at 14f-16f at Goodwood previously and proven in this going, is best placed to dictate and still find enough, while Caprelo and Gooloogong travelling prominently can pick up the pieces late. The honest tempo over 1m6f on Good to Firm will expose any stamina weakness, leaving those carrying big weights or stretching the trip to struggle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is competitive but not excessive, allowing Caprelo or Gooloogong to track the leaders efficiently and hit the front at the two-furlong pole without being tested for raw stamina.
scenarios.body: Caprelo has won and placed twice over this exact trip at Sandown and Goodwood and races prominently, making him ideally suited to latch onto a genuine pace and power through. Gooloogong won over this trip at Sandown in similar conditions and with Benoit de la Sayette aboard holds strong course credentials.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Closers Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace burns very hot and the front-runners come back to the field in the final two furlongs, gifting ground to those held up further back.
scenarios.body: Russian Rumour has placed six times at this track and stays well, and Zachary Hickes is unexposed over the distance stepping up from 12f where he won at Goodwood last time. However, Arcturus Flame, Taritino and Educator — the most natural closers — are likely pushed into midfield rather than their ideal rear position, blunting the true closer threat.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Interference Mid-Race
scenarios.trigger: If the congested midfield — caused by the surplus of hold-up types redistributed out of position — creates traffic problems in the straight, gifting a clean-running hold-up horse a winning passage.
scenarios.body: A troubled run scenario over 1m6f at Goodwood's sweeping straight tends to produce a winner who gets a clean passage late rather than the fastest finisher, with Russian Rumour's course experience and Appier's tactical versatility making them the standout beneficiaries. Appier won over 14f at Goodwood on soft and is capable of varying his position, giving David Probert options if gaps open.

watchPoints.text: Scarlet Moon and Two Plus Two will contest the early lead — if neither concedes, the pace could become genuinely hot over 1m6f on Good to Firm, which would dramatically compromise both their winning chances and reward hold-up horses who find daylight.

Arcturus Flame, Taritino and Educator are all natural hold-up performers forced into midfield by the volume of closers in this field — watch for all three to race out of their preferred position, reducing their effectiveness and potentially creating congestion in the straight around the 3f-2f mark.

Zachary Hickes is stepping from 12f to 16f for the first time — if he handles the trip, Roger Varian's excellent T14 form (6/17) and a recent Goodwood win make him a live player, but any sign of stopping in the final furlong would confirm the trip is beyond him at this stage.

Russian Rumour's combination of Olivia Tubb's 5lb claim and an outstanding Goodwood record (2W, 6P from 15 similar-going runs) deserves respect — watch whether the nine-year-old is positioned to challenge from the home turn rather than making a deep late run.

Two Plus Two's stamina at 16f is unproven — watch the final furlong to see if this horse drops away sharply, which would be a crucial form pointer for future handicap assessments over this trip and beyond.

races.name: Virgin Bet Supports Safe Gambling Handicap Stakes

runners_data.name: All Ways Glamorous
runners_data.note: Rock-solid Goodwood record with four wins or places from five runs here over this exact trip, prominently ridden by Gina Mangan; good to firm ground poses no issue and three wins at 5f Goodwood on similar conditions make her a course specialist to respect at OR 97.
runners_data.comment: Back-to-back wins two and three starts back make All Ways Glamorous interesting, but a fourth last time out and our rating placing him last-but-one in a field of eight make him hard to fancy, even if he has experience over today's trip and going.

runners_data.name: Lexington Blitz
runners_data.note: One of two confirmed front-runners here, fitted with a hood and trained by Cowell who is 1/11 in the last 14 days; will look to boss proceedings from the gates but faces direct competition for the lead from stablemate Democracy Dilemma, which complicates his chance of controlling the race.

runners_data.name: Toca Madera
runners_data.note: Tudhope takes the ride for O'Meara and this five-year-old is a genuine hold-up horse who will be settled at the back; has the best record on good to firm among the hold-up contingent with 14 qualifying runs on similar ground, and the pace scenario here should play to his late thrust if the front-runners tie each other up.
runners_data.comment: Toca Madera showed plenty of promise when third two starts back, and with experience of today's trip and going under his belt, he arrives here fresh on a seven-day turnaround with our rating putting him right in contention; the risk is that he has been winless in recent starts.

runners_data.name: Democracy Dilemma
runners_data.note: The other Cowell front-runner, wearing visor and tongue strap for the first time today, making her tactical profile harder to read; has a modest record at Goodwood (1W1P from 9 runs on this course and going) and the clash with Lexington Blitz means she is unlikely to dominate at a controlled tempo.
runners_data.comment: Fifth last time out and fourth two starts back, Democracy Dilemma arrives 21 days fresh with distance and going experience to call on, though winless in his last six starts, carrying 138 lb from stall five may test his resolution at a rating of 95.

runners_data.name: Naana's Sparkle
runners_data.note: Fitted with a tongue strap and races prominently, giving O'Neill a simple brief to track the pace from a handy pitch; two wins from 15 on good to firm is workable, and her best form has come at 5f on courses where a strong pace has been set for her to swoop onto.

runners_data.name: Kylian
runners_data.note: A genuine hold-up horse for Cowell, wearing a visor, and one of three from the same yard in this race; Bishop rides him and his course form is mixed (1W2P from 8 qualifying runs), though a truly run race at 5f Goodwood is his best scenario and he is not without each-way claims if the pace is brutal.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts, Kylian at least returns on a quick turnaround of 13 days and has run over today's trip and going before, but a fourth last time out represents his best recent effort and the weight of 132 lb from stall 3 makes life no easier.

runners_data.name: Dyonisos
runners_data.note: Prominent racer for Probert and Ian Williams, 32 days since last run, with a win at 5f Goodwood on his record (1W5P from 10 similar-going runs); freshness could be a positive or negative, but his OR of 88 means he is racing off a lenient mark if finding form on his return.
runners_data.comment: Ranked bottom of the field on our figures, Dyonisos is hard to fancy off 131 lb from stall 7, and his latest run was a ninth; however, he does own a win in his last six starts and has run over today's distance and going before, offering slim consolation.

runners_data.name: Dream Composer
runners_data.note: Carroll's eight-year-old is a natural hold-up horse whose form figures include a recent win at 5f Goodwood; shifted into the midfield on the map because genuine hold-up slots are already filled, but his true racing pattern is to come from off the pace — the [STYLE_FIT] flag is a fair caution that he may not get the clean late run his style demands in a compressed field.
runners_data.comment: Dream Composer won three starts back and has run over today's trip and going, but a fourth last time out and a fifth two starts back suggest he is finding the opposition stiff at present; 127 lb from stall six is no aid, though the step up in our rating to 95 hints at residual ability.

races.paceDynamic: Lexington Blitz and Democracy Dilemma are both confirmed front-runners for Robert Cowell's yard, and their head-to-head battle for the rail and early supremacy will set a genuine, pressured gallop from the outset on this sharp Goodwood 5f. With both likely to push hard for position, neither will be able to dictate on their own terms, and the resulting strong early fractions should string the field out quickly on good to firm ground. The pace scenario therefore favours hold-up and prominent horses who can settle in behind the speed and pick up ground in the final two furlongs, with early-pace absorbers the primary beneficiaries. This field contains more prominent and front-running types than the race shape can accommodate — All Ways Glamorous and Naana's Sparkle are both genuine prominent racers and are most likely to secure their natural positions just off the early leaders, while Dream Composer, a true hold-up type, has been redistributed to midfield on the map simply because the rear of the field is already accounted for by Toca Madera and Kylian.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Contested Pace, Closers Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Lexington Blitz and Democracy Dilemma burn each other off at the head of affairs and leave the race wide open for hold-up and late types.
scenarios.body: The two front-runners push each other into a strong early gallop, tying each other up through the first two furlongs; horses settled in mid-to-rear then get a clean passage up the Goodwood straight and finish powerfully. True hold-up horses and prominent types who travel smoothly within themselves are firmly in the driving seat.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Lone Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Democracy Dilemma (visor, tongue strap) is more tractable than expected and Lexington Blitz fails to go with her early, allowing one to slip clear and control fractions.
scenarios.body: One front-runner establishes a clear lead within the first furlong at a manageable pace, controls the tempo, and the field never gets close enough to reel them in on the descent. The winner is the horse who secures the front uncontested and can sustain the gallop on quick ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Stalkers Score
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but not truly scorching, and the horses racing just off the speed in the first two positions behind the leaders get the ideal stalking trip.
scenarios.body: All Ways Glamorous and Naana's Sparkle, both genuine prominent types with strong Goodwood course form, are ideally placed to pounce as the front-runners tighten each other up, hitting the rising ground full of running. This shape rewards horses with tactical pace who travel prominently and quicken on fast ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Hold-Up Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the early battle between the two front-runners is so fierce that they capitulate in the final furlong, handing the race to a late charger from deep.
scenarios.body: Toca Madera or Kylian, settled at the rear of the small field, get a clear run up the stands rail and swoop late as the pace horses fold; the key is whether they can make enough ground on a flat, sharp track with no bend to aid their challenge. This shape is less likely given the straight nature of Goodwood 5f and the quality of the prominent horses, but not impossible if fractions are extreme.

watchPoints.text: Watch whether Lexington Blitz or Democracy Dilemma blinks first in the opening furlong — if one of them capitulates and goes wide or gets outpaced, the remaining front-runner could steal several lengths on the field.

All Ways Glamorous has won at this course and distance four times; if Gina Mangan can settle her just off the duelling front-runners in a clean position, she is a serious danger regardless of race shape.
Toca Madera is drawn wide and will be furthest from the action early; Tudhope will need a gap to open up the Goodwood straight or his late run will be strangled in a small field of eight.

Robert Cowell saddles three runners (Lexington Blitz, Democracy Dilemma, Kylian) — stable jockey alignment and instructions will be critical; watch which horse Cowell's retained rider Mitchell is aboard (Lexington Blitz) as a potential guide to yard confidence.

Dream Composer's redistribution means he may not secure his preferred berth at the rear; if the pace is only modest, his usual late challenge will be blunted and backers should be aware he is racing in a less-than-ideal tactical position.
